commentary.2026-06-16: A build-and-align day: stood up a personal work-tracking framework and dashboard, moved Copilot assets into a private repo, and synced with the team on the Bedrock data-platform architecture.

notes.text: Now is the time for all good men

notes.text: Priority is to work on ADO item 445704

Bedrock Data Platform Architecture and Layered Approach: Jesus, Jim, and Sri discussed the Bedrock data platform architecture, focusing on the medallion layering (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum), the role of semantic models, custom mappings, and the hub-and-spoke topology, with Jesus providing technical details and open questions about capacity, grain, and future tooling

sessions.title: Workflow cleanup
sessions.accomplishment: Developing a workflow for tracking work

notes.text: Learned about Fabric CLI — a command-line tool for managing Microsoft Fabric: create/manage workspaces, items (lakehouses, notebooks, pipelines), and automate tasks from the terminal/CI. Install with `pip install ms-fabric-cli` (on Win ARM64 pin `cryptography==46.0.3` first).
